messages:
jess: Hi @santiago — saw your ticket about rerank returning 512-d vectors instead of 768. Can you paste the request_id and a short curl you used? :eyes:

santiago: thanks jess. request_id: req_92f1c3b4. Happened on prod at 2025-11-02T17:22:13Z. Using model rwd-rerank-v1, batch size 8. I'll paste curl below.

vikram: quick Q — are you sending raw embeddings in 'documents' or using the 'vectors' field? often shape mismatch comes from swapping those.

santiago: sending under documents[].embedding. curl below (redacted vector content):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-rerank-v1","queries":["what is the refund policy?"],"documents":[{"id":"d1","embedding":[0.1,0.2,...,0.512 elements...]},{"id":"d2","embedding":[...512 elements...]}],"top_k":5}'
```

jess: that curl looks syntactically fine — the error header you got from the API would help. Can you paste response headers (X-Request-ID, X-Trace-ID) and the error payload?

santiago: response headers: X-Request-ID: req_92f1c3b4, X-Trace-ID: trace-7f4a. Response body: {"error":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 768 got 512"} 

vikram: OK that matches the classic case where the model artifact expects 768 but the client sent a 512-length vector. Two likely causes: (1) client-side model/encoder produced 512-d vectors (mismatch in encoder version) or (2) the server routing used a smaller model variant by mistake.

vikram: can you run a minimal repro so we can capture request/response and reduce noise? use this minimal curl that sends a single tiny payload and include -i to dump headers:
```bash
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-rerank-v1","queries":["q"],"documents":[{"id":"x","embedding":[0.0,0.0, /* repeat to 512 */ ]}],"top_k":1}'
```

jess: while you run that, please trigger a debug bundle for the request_id so we get the router logs + kernel selection trace. Run: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood.com/debug/bundles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -F "request_id=req_92f1c3b4" \
  -F "include_logs=true" \
  -F "since=2025-11-02T17:20:00Z"
```
(we'll need the bundle id once created)

deploy-bot: bundle_created id=bundle_20251102_001 size=12MB link=https://internal.redwood.com/bundles/bundle_20251102_001

jess: got the bundle link, forwarding to eng. vikram can you check the bundle for the router:kernel selection logs and model manifest? look for fields: embedding_size, quant_profile, variant_id.

vikram: digging into bundle... model manifest inside shows embedding_size=768, variant_id=v1.2.1, quant_profile=fp16. Router trace shows this request routed to pool-dedicated-3 and kernel selector logged: selected_kernel=kv_cache_v2. No immediate red flags, but I see an older artifact for the encoder service (encoder-v0.9) in the same workflow; that encoder outputs 512 by default.

vikram: root cause: client used a bundled encoder that produces 512 dims (encoder-v0.9). We should either: (A) update client to use encoder-v1.1 (768) or (B) allow server-side auto-upgrade/routing to an encoder-compatible variant. I'll prepare a short mitigation to surface a clearer error and add a pre-validation check in the rerank API to return expected dims in the 4xx body.

santiago: for immediate fix we switched client to encoder-v1.1 and re-ran. Repro curl now returns 200. Thanks.

jess: great — can you paste the final success response headers and confirm the request_id for the successful run?

santiago: success run headers: X-Request-ID: req_92f1c3b4-retry1, X-Trace-ID: trace-7f4a-retry. Response: 200, body includes reranked ids.

vikram: I'll follow up with a tiny PR to the SDK warning when a client encoder produces dims != model.expected_embedding_size. Also adding a note in the support KB with reproducible curl snippet and typical diagnostics.

jess: filing a short incident note and closing CS ticket since customer confirmed fix. ETA for SDK PR: 2 days. Closing thread when PR merged. :thumbsup:
